intro.text: A swampy region of the Rose Empire, bordering the mountains of Mulla'dil.

description.text: It is the homeland of Bloodsealing. Other nations tend to see that magic as sinister, yet the Grands are still willing to hire its practitioners.
Within the empire it keeps a distinct culture of its own, and its people and their neighbors, the Strikers, hate each other intensely.
Dzhamarians are extremely pale: their skin is milky and nearly see-through, their hair white and their eyes red. Their movements seem strangely unnatural, and to outsiders they often look ageless.
